pages.body:
# The NATURA wing — nature's regularities, kept sovereign from UNI's build status

The rest of this encyclopedia describes **UNI**: what the program built, at what evidence
class, with the negatives printed. This wing describes **nature**: the regularities that
were measured by other people, in published work, long before UNI existed.

It exists to serve one mandate — that a builder be able to reason about design "down to the
cell level," about "the ratios and frequencies," about "mind body mind.body world," and about
how to "research observe and make new science with falsifiable evidence to always use nature
as the authority of where we will find the next breakthrough" — across rocks, water, air,
stars, DNA, sperm, ants, dinosaurs, whales, bats, humans, and the open question beyond.

That mandate is answerable only if the wing is disciplined about a distinction the rest of the
corpus never had to make: **the difference between a gate UNI held and a measurement somebody
else published.** Both are evidence. They are not the same kind, and they do not license the
same moves.

**The honest program position is untouched by every chapter in this wing, and this wing can
never change it: ~2 of 11+ developmental rungs earned; a developmental active-inference
SIMULATION; a toy world, never a person.** If a NATURA chapter ever appears to move that
number, the chapter is the defect.

---

## THE SOVEREIGNTY RULE (read this before anything else in the wing)

**A nature citation is NEVER a UNI gate.**

Reading Kleiber's law raises no UNI rung. Citing Douady & Couder does not make any UNI claim
`proven`. A chapter that lets a literature citation imply a UNI capability has committed a
lane-crossing and is defective — regardless of how good the citation is.

This corpus carries **two sovereign evidence vocabularies, and they are never merged:**

| | **The UNI 4-value fence** | **The NATURA 12-value class** |
|---|---|---|
| Describes | **UNI's own build status** | **nature's** observed regularities |
| Values | `proven` · `designed` · `hypothesized` · `not-yet-built` | twelve, in three groups (below) |
| Measured by | UNI's own gates (PASS / FAIL / NEGATIVE / PENDING) | third parties, in published literature |
| Governed by | [`../CLAIM-LEDGER.md`](../CLAIM-LEDGER.md) | [`../NATURE-LEDGER.md`](../NATURE-LEDGER.md) |

**The twelve classes, in three groups** (defined in full, with a worked example of each, in
[NA-00](NA-00-how-to-read-this-wing.md); this is a pointer, not a restatement):

- **Group A — measured** *(the class says how much independent corroboration exists)*:
  `OBSERVED-REPLICATED` · `OBSERVED-SINGLE` · `OBSERVED-CONTESTED`
- **Group B — derived** *(the class says the assumptions are the fence)*:
  `MODELED` · `MODELED-CONTESTED` · `HYPOTHESIZED`
- **Group C — fenced** *(the row carries no usable value; the class says precisely why not —
  these are **not** interchangeable)*: `INADMISSIBLE` · `SUPERSEDED` · `NOT-MEASURED` ·
  `NOT-SOURCED` · `NOT-CONFIRMED` · `NOT-LOCATED`

The two ledgers are cross-referenced **by explicit audited link only, never by merge.** There is
no operation that takes a NATURA row and a UNI row and produces a stronger row of either kind.
**`proven` is reserved for UNI-ledger status and never describes nature's science** — not even
this wing's own best-replicated rows.

**One fence inside Group C is load-bearing and is stated twice on purpose: `NOT-SOURCED` is
never `NOT-MEASURED`.** NOT-MEASURED is an absence **in the literature** — a reportable fact
about the world's knowledge. NOT-SOURCED is an absence **in this corpus's own homework** — a
fact about *us*. Collapsing them would let a research failure masquerade as a discovery about
the frontier of science.

**TRUE and HONEST stay sovereign.** Every one of the twelve classes is a TRUE-side instrument:
falsifiable, reproducible, recalibratable. Lived experience is **never calibrated** — a
chakra-frequency table is INADMISSIBLE as physics and may be recorded as an HONEST/cultural
signal, never as a TRUE/measured one, and never converted between them. The wing's only
HONEST-class row (`CN11-59`, first-person testimony) is deliberately given **no** NATURA class.

**Supremacy.** Where a chapter and the ledger disagree, **the ledger wins and the chapter is
wrong** — the same rule the UNI side already runs.

---

## The chapters (all 23)

The **fence** column is each chapter's own `## HONEST FENCE` line, read from the chapter itself
— not inferred from its title, and not a summary of it. It is the fence on the **chapter as an
artifact**; individual rows inside carry their own classes, and **those govern**. A chapter
fenced MODELED is typically a budget or a composition: it runs measured constants through stated
assumptions, and *the assumptions are the fence*.

### Reference chapters — `encyclopedia/wing-NATURA/`

| Chapter | What it covers | Honest fence |
|---|---|---|
| [NA-00 — How to read this wing](NA-00-how-to-read-this-wing.md) | the wing's constitution: the twelve classes, the cardinal rule, the crosswalk against the UNI fence, and the amendment record | **NOT-MEASURED** |
| [NA-01 — Nature as the authority](NA-01-nature-as-the-authority.md) | why the already-run experiment is authoritative; convergence as constraint-optimum; the Gould & Lewontin counterweight in full; **the operable protocol (§6) is the payload** | **HYPOTHESIZED** |
| [NA-02 — The one loop](NA-02-the-one-loop.md) | active inference stated exactly (VFE to understand, EFE to choose), with its math in readable ASCII — and the best published objections at equal seriousness | **MODELED** |
| [NA-03 — How to make new science](NA-03-how-to-make-new-science.md) | the operable procedure for turning an observation into a claim that can be killed: strong inference, severity, pre-registration, tuned baselines, discriminators, and how a negative gets published | **OBSERVED-REPLICATED** |
| [NA-04 — Mind / body / mind.body / world](NA-04-mind-body-world.md) | the Markov blanket given exactly; each of the four words mapped to one of its four sets; the nesting across scales — then a last third arguing against itself | **MODELED** |
| [NA-05 — The ratios](NA-05-ratios-and-scaling-laws.md) | allometry and scaling across 20+ orders of magnitude; the exponent is the science, the prefactor is the engineering; Kleiber's dispute carried at full strength | **OBSERVED-CONTESTED** |
| [NA-06 — The frequencies](NA-06-frequencies-rhythm-and-resonance.md) | nature's *rates* separated from nature's *rumours*: Strouhal, Schumann, alpha, circadian — the earned/unearned split, with the receipts for both | **OBSERVED-CONTESTED** |
| [NA-07 — The dimensionless numbers](NA-07-dimensionless-numbers.md) | the cross-scale design toolkit: Reynolds, Péclet, Damköhler and kin; why dimensionless groups travel across scale and ratios usually do not | **MODELED** |
| [NA-08 — Cell-level design](NA-08-cell-level-design.md) | a working budget for the cell as an engineered artifact: what sets its size, what it spends, what its machines deliver, where its sensing hits a physical floor | **MODELED** |
| [NA-09 — Morphogenesis](NA-09-morphogenesis-and-development.md) | the bridge from cell to organism: pattern from local rules, reaction–diffusion, and a morphogen gradient as a measured concentration profile | **OBSERVED-CONTESTED** |
| [NA-10 — The scale ladder](NA-10-the-scale-ladder-and-gradients.md) | a rung-by-rung placement table across ~36 orders of magnitude — and the rule for knowing when a number fitted on one rung stops meaning anything on the next | **MODELED** |

### Recipes — `cookbook/recipes-natura/`

Each is a buildable recipe carrying its own NATURA classes and its own falsifier.

| Recipe | What it covers | Honest fence |
|---|---|---|
| [CN-01 — Rocks](../../cookbook/recipes-natura/CN-01-rocks.md) | the mineral substrate everything else is made of and stands on; the wing's reference case for **a boundary with no internal model** — the zero of the ladder | **MODELED** |
| [CN-02 — Water](../../cookbook/recipes-natura/CN-02-water.md) | the spec sheet of the medium every other chapter silently assumes; a pile of anomalies life is built **on**, and the substance that attracts the most unearned mysticism while being measurably stranger than it | **MODELED** |
| [CN-03 — Air](../../cookbook/recipes-natura/CN-03-air.md) | the atmosphere as a working fluid: composition, density, momentum, sound, light, its heat engine, and where it refuses to hold you up | **MODELED** |
| [CN-04 — Stars](../../cookbook/recipes-natura/CN-04-stars.md) | the provenance chain for the matter in NA-08's cell, proton to carbon to gold; a star read as a negative-feedback control system | **MODELED** |
| [CN-05 — DNA](../../cookbook/recipes-natura/CN-05-dna.md) | the information substrate as a physical polymer — measured dimensions, information content, error rate, packing, copy speed — and the deflation of reading DNA as source code | **MODELED** |
| [CN-06 — Sperm](../../cookbook/recipes-natura/CN-06-sperm.md) | the minimal motile delivery vehicle, designed against a spec that admits no negotiation; the physics writes most of the requirements document | **MODELED** |
| [CN-07 — Ants](../../cookbook/recipes-natura/CN-07-ants.md) | the colony as a distributed system whose coordination lives in the shared environment rather than in any component's model of the whole | **OBSERVED-CONTESTED** |
| [CN-08 — Dinosaurs](../../cookbook/recipes-natura/CN-08-dinosaurs.md) | falsifiable science on a system you can never observe; the animals are the worked example, **the epistemics are the payload** | **MODELED** |
| [CN-09 — Whales](../../cookbook/recipes-natura/CN-09-whales.md) | what sets a maximum once buoyancy deletes the bone-stress ceiling; low-frequency sound as a long-baseline information channel, with the units trap that makes most "loudness" comparisons wrong | **MODELED** |
| [CN-10 — Bats](../../cookbook/recipes-natura/CN-10-bats.md) | the wing's **keystone chapter for the method**: the one animal that exposes active inference in Hz, dB, ms and metres — where the epistemic term becomes an instrument reading | **MODELED** |
| [CN-11 — Humans](../../cookbook/recipes-natura/CN-11-humans.md) | the human body as measured quantities with the flattery stripped out; famous numbers carried **with the receipt of their correction** | **MODELED** |
| [CN-12 — Beyond human](../../cookbook/recipes-natura/CN-12-beyond-human-open-question.md) | **not a recipe.** A QUAESTIO-APERTA register entry: it maps the constraint space and states what would falsify each claim people make about it. No target, no milestone, no roadmap — and there must never be one | **HYPOTHESIZED / QUAESTIO-APERTA** |

---

## Reading order, if you are here to DESIGN something

Canonical in [NA-00](NA-00-how-to-read-this-wing.md#reading-order-if-you-are-here-to-design-something)
and carried here unchanged. The order is deliberate; the reasons are the point.

1. **NA-00** — the vocabulary and the cardinal rule. **Non-skippable.**
2. **NA-03** — the method *before* the content, so you cannot mistake an inspiration for a result.
3. **NA-01** — the authority doctrine **and its counterweight**, together, in that order.
4. **NA-07, then NA-05** — dimensionless numbers before ratios. **Dimensionless groups survive a
   change of scale and most ratios do not.** Reading NA-05 first is how designers end up with
   golden ratios in places nature never put one.
5. **The scale chapter you need** — NA-08 (cell), NA-09 (form), or NA-10 (ladder).
6. **The CN recipe for your target** — and only now.
7. **Back to NA-03** — write the pre-registered metric and the tuned baseline *before* you build.
   A biomimetic design with no baseline is not a design; it is a story.

---

## The ledger, the machine twin, and the mechanical check

- **[`../NATURE-LEDGER.md`](../NATURE-LEDGER.md) — the wing's ledger of record. 919 rows**, extracted
  from every `## The numbers` table across these 23 chapters and carried whole. It is extraction
  only: no row was added that no chapter contains, and no value was invented, improved, averaged,
  rounded, or completed. Ranges and disputes are carried whole and never averaged. **Where a chapter
  and the ledger disagree, the ledger wins.** (918 table rows + `NA03-16`, which NA-03 places in its
  prose on purpose = 919; the reconciliation is disclosed at its §2.)
- **[`../../gpt/knowledge/K20-constants-ratios-and-nature-ledger.json`](../../gpt/knowledge/K20-constants-ratios-and-nature-ledger.json)
  — the machine-readable twin.** The categorised view: constants, dimensionless numbers, scaling
  laws, frequencies, the INADMISSIBLE register, and the open questions, every entry tracing to its
  chapter. Both files are generated from one extraction pass and cannot disagree.
- **[`../../tools/verify_class_vocabulary.py`](../../tools/verify_class_vocabulary.py) — the mechanical
  check.** The operable form of NA-00's falsifier #2, pre-registered *before* the amendment it tests.
  It fails on any row outside the registered vocabulary, across three scopes — the ledger, K20, and
  **the chapters themselves** — and prints every scope it covers before it prints any result. Re-run
  it after any edit to any of them.

---

## The honest residue (stated here, not buried)

Two things these amendments did **not** fix. They are printed in the index because an index that
points only at the clean parts is not an index, it is an advertisement.

1. **The 22 untraced rows.** The `NOT-SOURCED` (20), `NOT-CONFIRMED` (1) and `NOT-LOCATED` (1) rows
   are now *correctly labelled*, which is **not** the same as *fixed*. Twenty-two rows carry values
   this corpus could not fully trace. **Naming a defect precisely is not repairing it.** Each carries
   the falsifier that would close it, and closing them is real work that has not been done.
2. **The 52 chapter rows, and the day they were wrong.** **AMENDMENT 2026-07-15-A closed
   `NATURE-LEDGER.md` and K20 — those two files, and nothing else.** **52 rows across 10 of these 23
   chapters went on carrying PRE-amendment class strings** (42 bare/qualified `OBSERVED`, 3
   `NEGATIVE`, 5 `as above`, 2 CN-05 cells not leading with a token) until **AMENDMENT 2026-07-15-C**
   re-classed them in lockstep with the ledger. For one day the extraction and the extracted
   disagreed in the one column the amendment existed to fix — and three of those cells printed
   `NEGATIVE`, a **UNI ledger state**, in the Class column of a NATURA table: the cardinal rule was
   argued correctly in the ledger and violated in the chapters. **The verifier reported PASS anyway,
   because it never opened a chapter.** They are labelled correctly now. What is *not* repaired is
   the reason it happened: nothing in the record disclosed the gap — **it took an outside audit to
   find it.** The instrument is fixed; the habit that produced it is not demonstrated fixed, and one
   closed scope gap is not evidence there is no second one.

Read [NA-00's Amendment record](NA-00-how-to-read-this-wing.md#amendment-record-2026-07-15) and
[NATURE-LEDGER §3.2](../NATURE-LEDGER.md) for the full accounting — including why **50 and 52 are
both right** under two different instruments (`52 − 5 + 3 = 50`), and why a count is not a fact until
the rule that produced it is named.

---

> **Provenance.** This index points; it asserts no fact about nature of its own. The wing's
> constitution is [`NA-00`](NA-00-how-to-read-this-wing.md), which defines the twelve classes and
> the cardinal rule; the ledger of record is [`../NATURE-LEDGER.md`](../NATURE-LEDGER.md), and where
> this index and the ledger disagree, **the ledger wins and this index is wrong.** Every fence in the
> tables above was read from that chapter's own `## HONEST FENCE` section, and every count restated
> here (919 rows · 72 of 919 outside the original six · 22 untraced · 52 chapter rows across 10 files)
> is quoted from NA-00's Amendment record and NATURE-LEDGER §3.2 / §5, not re-derived. The class
> vocabulary is machine-checked by
> [`../../tools/verify_class_vocabulary.py`](../../tools/verify_class_vocabulary.py) across the
> ledger, K20, and these chapters. The sibling index for the UNI side of the corpus — a sovereign
> ledger, a sovereign vocabulary, never merged with this one — is [`../00-INDEX.md`](../00-INDEX.md).
> **A nature citation is never a UNI gate. Falsify any row.**

pages.title: NA-00 — How to read the NATURA wing (the second sovereign vocabulary)
pages.body:
# NA-00 — How to read the NATURA wing (the second sovereign vocabulary)

> **What you are reading.** The constitution of the NATURA wing. This chapter defines the wing's
> evidence vocabulary, fences it away from the UNI claim ledger with a hard rule, and maps
> the wing. Read it before any other NA or CN chapter. It asserts no fact about nature of its own —
> every number in it is a worked example, carrying its own class, its own citation, and its own
> falsifier.
>
> **AMENDED 2026-07-15.** This chapter originally declared a **six-value** vocabulary — "six classes
> and only six." That declaration was **wrong**, and the corpus proved it wrong: 72 of the 919 rows
> the chapters actually wrote could not be placed in any of the six. The vocabulary is now **twelve
> classes in three groups**, plus four individually-named rows that deliberately carry no class at
> all. The original wording, and the strike against it, are carried openly in
> [§ Amendment record](#amendment-record-2026-07-15) — not silently edited away.

---

## Why this wing exists

The rest of the encyclopedia describes **UNI**: what the program has built, at what evidence class,
with the negatives printed. This wing describes **nature**: the regularities that were measured by
other people, in published work, long before UNI existed.

The wing serves one mandate — that the science consultant be able to reason about design "down to the
cell level," about "the ratios and frequencies," about "mind body mind.body world," and about how to
"research observe and make new science with falsifiable evidence to always use nature as the
authority of where we will find the next breakthrough" — across "dna sperm ants dinosaurs whales bats
rocks water air stars humans" and the open question beyond.

That mandate is answerable only if the wing is disciplined about a distinction the rest of the corpus
never had to make: **the difference between a gate UNI held and a measurement somebody else
published.** Both are evidence. They are not the same kind, they do not license the same moves, and
the whole wing turns on never confusing them.

Per [`../../README.md`](../../README.md), this wing's ledger of record is
[`../NATURE-LEDGER.md`](../NATURE-LEDGER.md). Every row in every NA/CN chapter is written to be
admissible there. Where a chapter and the ledger disagree, **the ledger wins and the chapter is
wrong** — the same supremacy rule the UNI side already runs.

---

## The cardinal rule

**A nature citation is never a UNI gate.**

Reading Kleiber's law raises no UNI rung. Citing Douady & Couder does not make any UNI claim
`proven`. A chapter that lets a literature citation imply a UNI capability has committed a
lane-crossing and is defective — full stop, regardless of how good the citation is.

This is not a new rule. It is the same fence the corpus already applies to the embodiment substrate
("UNI.OS substrate evidence is **never** general-AIF evidence"), and the same one behind M9's class
authority ordering. The NATURA wing simply gives it a second front. The two ledgers are
cross-referenced **by explicit audited link only, never by merge.** There is no operation that takes
a NATURA row and a UNI row and produces a stronger row of either kind.

The honest program position is unchanged by anything in this wing, and this wing can never change it:
**~2 of 11+ developmental rungs earned.** If a NATURA chapter ever appears to move that number, the
chapter is the defect.

---

## The classes, with a worked example of each

The UNI fence has four values (`proven` · `designed` · `hypothesized` · `not-yet-built`) and the
UNI ledger has four states (PASS / FAIL / NEGATIVE / PENDING). Neither vocabulary is used in this
wing.

> **STRICKEN 2026-07-15 — the original wording, carried on record:**
> *"This wing uses six classes and only six."*
> **It was false.** 72 of the 919 rows the chapters wrote (7.8%) carried a class string outside the
> six, because the six could not express what those rows had actually observed. See
> [§ Amendment record](#amendment-record-2026-07-15). This wing now uses **twelve classes in three
> groups** — and the count is a measured property of the corpus, not a design target. If a
> thirteenth is needed, that is a finding, and the same amendment procedure applies.

The three groups answer three different questions. **Group A — measured:** somebody put an
instrument on nature; the class says *how much independent corroboration exists*. **Group B —
derived:** the number came out of a model; the class says *the assumptions are the fence*.
**Group C — fenced:** the row carries no usable value, and the class says *precisely why not* — the
ways of being empty are **not interchangeable**, and collapsing them is how a corpus starts lying.

### Group A — measured

**OBSERVED-REPLICATED** — measured, and independently replicated across labs, datasets, or taxa.
Carries a real citation, a falsifier, and the known range.
*Worked example:* the Schumann resonance fundamental, ≈ 7.83 Hz. Predicted by Schumann (1952),
first extracted from background noise by Balser & Wagner (1960), *Nature* 188:638–641, and measured
at ELF stations worldwide since. It is a real Earth–ionosphere cavity resonance. Note what the class
does *not* buy: it licenses the frequency, not any claim attached to the frequency.

**OBSERVED-SINGLE** — *(registered 2026-07-15; 42 rows)* measured, by a method another party could
repeat, but **no independent replication is on record.** One line of evidence: a single study, a
single group, a single report, or a single chain through a review. The class asserts the
measurement and asserts **nothing** about corroboration.
*Why it had to exist — the corpus's own words.* CN-07 stated the reason exactly, and it is the
whole argument for this class: *"OBSERVED-REPLICATED asserts a replication that did not happen, and
OBSERVED-CONTESTED asserts a dispute that does not exist. Both are false, in opposite directions."*
A measured-but-unreplicated result forced into either neighbour is a lie in a known direction;
under the six, 42 rows had no honest home.
*Worked example:* CN09-26 — nitrogen-washout collapse depth in *Tursiops truncatus*, ~70 m
(Ridgway & Howard 1979, *Science* 206(4423):1182–1183). Real measurement, real citation, one group,
never independently repeated.
*Falsifier — the promotion and the demotion, both live:* an independent replication **promotes** it
to OBSERVED-REPLICATED; a failed independent replication **demotes** it to OBSERVED-CONTESTED (or,
if withdrawn, SUPERSEDED). Until one of those happens, the row stays here — and "nobody has tried"
is a fact about the literature, printed as one.

**OBSERVED-CONTESTED** — measured, but the community genuinely disputes the value, the exponent, or
the mechanism. Both positions must be carried and the dispute named. This is a feature, not an
embarrassment.
*Worked example:* the metabolic scaling exponent *b* in BMR ∝ M^*b*. Kleiber (1932) reported ≈ 0.74
(Brody, the same year, ≈ 0.73). Dodds, Rothman & Weitz (2001) re-analysed the classic datasets and
found little evidence for rejecting 2/3 in favour of 3/4. White & Seymour (2003) report
0.686 ± 0.014 (95% CI). The exponent **moves with the analysis choices** — which taxa are excluded,
whether body temperature is normalised, whether the regression unit is the species or the order. That
mobility *is* the dispute, and a chapter that picks one number and drops the other has lied.

### Group B — derived

**MODELED** — derived from a model that fits data. **The model's assumptions are the fence.**
*Worked example:* West, Brown & Enquist (1997) derive *b* = 3/4 exactly, from three assumptions: a
space-filling fractal branching network, terminal units invariant with body size, and minimised
energy dissipation. The derivation is clean. It is also conditional: drop any one assumption and the
3/4 does not follow. Cite it as MODELED and cite the assumptions with it, or do not cite it.

**MODELED-CONTESTED** — *(registered 2026-07-15; 1 row)* derived from a model, **and** the community
genuinely disputes it. Both positions carried, and the model's assumptions still the fence — the row
must survive both tests, not one. This class exists because the original six were treated as
disjoint and are not: MODELED and OBSERVED-CONTESTED overlap in reality, and a row landing in the
overlap was previously forced to drop one of its two true properties.
*Worked example:* CN12-31 — human behavioural throughput, ~10 bit/s (Zheng & Meister 2025, *Neuron*
113(2), a Perspective — a literature synthesis, not a new experiment), directly contested by
Sauerbrei & Pruszynski (2025), *Nat Neurosci*. Modeled **and** disputed; calling it MODELED alone
hides the dispute, calling it OBSERVED-CONTESTED alone claims a measurement nobody made.
*Falsifier:* a measure reconciling cognitive throughput and motor control under one accounting.

**HYPOTHESIZED** — mechanism proposed, not settled. Not claimed.
*Worked example:* the radical-pair mechanism of avian magnetoreception (Ritz et al., 2000; reviewed
in *PNAS*, DOI 10.1073/pnas.0711968106). Radio-frequency disruption experiments are consistent with
it, and behaviour at microtesla fields strengthens it (*Nature Communications*, DOI
10.1038/s41467-019-11655-2). Much of the supporting evidence remains circumstantial, and a competing
magnetite-based hypothesis is live. Birds navigate; *how* is not settled.

### Group C — fenced (the row carries no usable value; the class says why)

**INADMISSIBLE** — a claim that failed observation, or that is unfalsifiable as stated. Carried
**with the receipt of why it failed.** Never asserted, never mocked.
*Worked example:* "432 Hz is nature's true tuning." A4 = 440 Hz is a **convention** — ISO 16:1975
fixes it at 440 ± 0.5 Hz, not a natural constant — and 432 Hz is a different convention. Neither is
more natural, and the claim names no measurand that could distinguish them. Inadmissible as physics
or biology. The person asking is not stupid; the claim is just not shaped like a claim yet.

**SUPERSEDED** — *(registered 2026-07-15; 3 rows)* a value that **was** carried in the literature and
has since been **retracted, withdrawn by its own authors, or contradicted by a calibrated
re-analysis.** Kept as the **receipt for why it must not be cited** — never deleted, because
deleting it is how a superseded number gets re-imported by the next reader who finds it in an old
textbook. Distinct from INADMISSIBLE: an INADMISSIBLE claim was never shaped like a claim; a
SUPERSEDED value was a perfectly good claim that lost.
*Worked example:* CN01-34 — `f_bio,2008` ≈ 2/3 of 4,300 minerals as biologically mediated (Hazen et
al. 2008), **withdrawn by the authors themselves**. Scope cell reads: SUPERSEDED — DO NOT CITE.
*Falsifier:* this class's rows have **already had their falsifier fire.** That is what put them here.
*On the name — read this before "fixing" it.* These three rows were originally written `NEGATIVE`.
This amendment deliberately did **not** register that string, because **`NEGATIVE` is a UNI ledger
state** (PASS / FAIL / NEGATIVE / PENDING) and appears as such in the crosswalk below, where it is
paired against INADMISSIBLE. Registering `NEGATIVE` as a NATURA evidence class would have put one
token in both sovereign vocabularies at once — closing this defect by committing the exact
lane-crossing the cardinal rule exists to forbid. The rows' own cells already said *"SUPERSEDED
FRAMING"*, *"SUPERSEDED — DO NOT CITE"*, and *"contradicted by"*; `SUPERSEDED` is the class that was
always true of them. **The wing's separate, unrelated use of "NEGATIVE" — a biomimetic design that
failed to beat its tuned baseline under M7 — is untouched and stays UNI-side, where it belongs.**

**NOT-MEASURED** — the honest empty face: **nobody has measured it.** Write this instead of inventing
a number.
*Worked example:* the effect size of the Schumann resonance on human physiology at ambient field
strengths. The fields are in the **picotesla** range. This chapter searched and found no
pre-registered, independently replicated dose–response. That is not a refutation — it is an absence,
and the absence gets written down as an absence.

**NOT-SOURCED** — *(registered 2026-07-15; 20 rows)* the chapter **states a value it could not trace
to a source.** Somebody measured it; this corpus could not find who.
**This is NOT the same as NOT-MEASURED, and the difference is the whole point of registering it.**
NOT-MEASURED is an absence **in the literature** — a real, reportable fact about the world's
knowledge. NOT-SOURCED is an absence **in this corpus's own homework** — a fact about *us*, not about
nature. Collapsing the two would let a research failure masquerade as a discovery about the frontier
of science, which is among the worst things this wing could do. **Never merge them.**
*Falsifier:* produce the primary source. The row is then re-classed on its merits (usually
OBSERVED-SINGLE or OBSERVED-REPLICATED) — or, if no source exists, the value is struck.

**NOT-CONFIRMED** — *(registered 2026-07-15; 1 row)* the primary source **is named**, at one remove —
a secondary or tertiary work cites it — but the primary was **not read in this pass.** The provenance
chain is known and unwalked. Distinct from NOT-SOURCED, where no chain was found at all.
*Worked example:* CN10-53 — `f_click,B.trigona` up to 4,500 Hz, via a tertiary source citing Corcoran
et al. 2009; primary not read. *Falsifier:* read Corcoran et al. 2009, *Science* 325:325–7, and
confirm or strike.

**NOT-LOCATED** — *(registered 2026-07-15; 1 row)* a **named source was searched for and does not
appear to exist.** Strongest of the three provenance fences: not "we didn't look" (NOT-SOURCED) and
not "we didn't walk it" (NOT-CONFIRMED), but "we looked, and it wasn't there."
*Worked example:* CN12-40 — doctrine row `D3-08`, cited in the chapter's own commissioning brief; a
grep of `uni-onchip/design/` found no such row. The chapter reports the miss against **its own
brief** rather than quietly satisfying it. *Falsifier:* produce the row, or correct the citation.

> **The provenance fence, in one line.** NOT-MEASURED = *nature has not been asked.*
> NOT-SOURCED = *we cannot say who asked.* NOT-CONFIRMED = *we know who asked and did not read them.*
> NOT-LOCATED = *we checked, and the source named is not there.* Four different failures. Four
> different repairs. One of them is nature's; **three of them are ours.**

---

## Rows that deliberately carry NO class (registered as such, not classed)

Four rows carry no evidence class **on purpose.** They are named individually — this is a closed list
of four, not an open category, and a fifth may not be added by anyone who simply finds classing
inconvenient. Each is registered here so that a verifier can pass them without pretending they have a
class they do not have.

| Row | What it is | Why it is not classed |
|---|---|---|
| `NA03-16` | The SI defining constants (Δν_Cs, *c*, *h*, *e*, …), BIPM SI Brochure 9th ed., 2019 | **Definitional.** Exact by convention, effective 20 May 2019. They are **not observations of nature**, so no NATURA class applies. NA-03 puts them in the prose *below* its table on purpose. The chapter's instruction is the point: **know which of your numbers are conventions.** |
| `CN04-22` | Hoyle's 1953 **prediction** of the ~7.68 MeV carbon resonance | **A prediction is not a measurement.** SIGNUM SIGNUM MANET: the prediction and the measurement travel as **separate rows** — the measurement is `CN04-23` (Dunbar, Pixley, Wenzel & Whaling 1953), classed OBSERVED-REPLICATED on its own merits. Classing the prediction as if it were an observation would merge the two. |
| `CN11-59` | First-person testimony (CN-11) | **Not a NATURA class at all — see below.** |
| `CN12-41` | `anima in silicio?` / `silicium ut aqua?` | **A register status, not an evidence class — see below.** |

### CN11-59 — an HONEST signal. Not a NATURA class. Not calibrated. Ever.

The wing's only HONEST-class row is **not a NATURA row wearing an odd label**, and this amendment
explicitly **declines to give it a NATURA class.** It belongs to the **HONEST store**, which is
sovereign from the TRUE store and is **never calibrated** — that is the cardinal sin of this repo,
and closing a vocabulary defect is not a licence to commit it.

Every class in the twelve above is a **TRUE-side** instrument: each is falsifiable, reproducible, and
recalibratable, and each carries the falsifier that would move it. **Testimony has none of those
properties, and this is not a deficiency to be repaired.** The row's own falsifier cell says it
better than a rule could: *"None. Testimony is never calibrated — that is the point, not a gap."*

Forcing it into the TRUE-side vocabulary — even into an honest-looking fence like NOT-MEASURED —
would assert that first-person report is a failed measurement rather than a different kind of signal.
It would be a lane-crossing of exactly the kind the cardinal rule forbids, and it would be **wrong in
the direction that flatters the corpus**, which is the direction to distrust most. It is carried,
sovereign and uncalibrated, and it is **not counted in the twelve.**

### CN12-41 — NONDUM FALSIFICABILIS is a register status, *extra Arborem*

`NONDUM FALSIFICABILIS` ("not yet falsifiable") is **not an evidence class and never was.** It is a
**register status**: the mark of an item held in the QUAESTIONES APERTAE register, **extra Arborem**
(outside the Tree) — *leguntur, non aguntur*: **they are read, not acted upon.**

The distinction is load-bearing. An evidence class says *how well a claim about nature is supported.*
A register status says *this item is not in the ledger at all.* `CN12-41` — `anima in silicio?` /
`silicium ut aqua?` — offers **no falsifier**, and its source cell says why that is correct rather
than defective: **that is exactly why it lives in a register and not in a ledger.** A ledger row
without a falsifier would be a defect; a register entry without one is the register working.

Giving it an evidence class would import it into the Tree by relabelling — admitting through the
vocabulary something that has not passed the admission tests. It stays *extra Arborem*, and it is
**not counted in the twelve.**

---

## Compound rows (the "disjoint" half of falsifier #2, answered honestly)

Two rows carry **two classes**, because two *parts* of the row have different evidentiary standing:

- `CN05-31` — `ε_MMR`: **MODELED** (the ladder rung) · **OBSERVED-REPLICATED** (the overall band).
- `CN06-30` — **OBSERVED-SINGLE** (the latency) · **MODELED** (its identification with T).

The original design assumed every row lands in **exactly one** class. These two do not, and no
amount of vocabulary fixes that — the *row* has two parts, not the *class system*. Splitting them
into separate rows would be the tidier fix and is **deliberately not done**: the parts are only
meaningful together, and separating them invites a reader to cite the modeled half as if it were the
measured half. That is the merge this wing exists to prevent.

**The convention, registered:** a compound row names **each part's class to its part**, in the class
cell, in the order the parts appear. It is **counted at its leading class** (CN05-31 counts as
MODELED; CN06-30 as OBSERVED-SINGLE) — the count is a convention for arithmetic, and the class cell,
not the count, is authoritative for the row. **Compounds are rare and must stay rare:** two of 919.
A compound is admissible only when the parts genuinely cannot be separated. If they can be, split
them.

---

## Nature as the authority — stated precisely, and its counterweight

The doctrine is defensible in exactly one form:

> Nature is the authority because it is the only system that has **already run the experiment** — a
> very long parallel search under real physical constraints, in which the failures were deleted.
> Convergent evolution is **evidence of a constraint-optimum.**

And it is honest only with the counterweight, which travels with it **everywhere in this wing**:

> Not every trait is an adaptation (Gould & Lewontin 1979, *Proc. R. Soc. Lond. B* 205(1161):581–598).
> Phylogenetic inertia, drift, developmental constraint, pleiotropy and historical contingency all
> produce features that are not optimal solutions to anything. Nature is full of frozen accidents:
> the vertebrate retina is wired backwards; the recurrent laryngeal nerve takes its detour.

Therefore: **"nature does it this way" is a hypothesis generator, never a proof.** A biomimetic
design must still beat a **tuned conventional baseline** on a **pre-registered metric**, or it is
recorded NEGATIVE — the wing inherits M7 (contains-baseline + load-bearing discriminator) unchanged.
That paragraph is the entire difference between this wing and cargo-cult biomimicry.

The wing's own poster child polices this. Spiral phyllotaxis really does cluster near the golden
angle, and Douady & Couder (1992) reproduced it in a **physical ferrofluid-droplet experiment** from
simple repulsion dynamics — mechanism, not mysticism. It is earned. And in the largest sunflower
study with explicit, checkable inclusion criteria, Swinton & Ochu (2016) found **18% of scored counts
were non-Fibonacci** — roughly one in five, in the organism the claim is named after. The regularity
is real. The universality is not. Both facts are printed here, together, and the second one is the
reason to trust the first.

---

## The honesty rail

- **RES IPSAE, NON SIMULACRA.** No fabricated numbers. Every value carries a real citation, or it is
  written `NOT-MEASURED`. **There is no third state.** A plausible-sounding number with no source is
  the worst defect available in this wing. If you half-remember a value, search for it; if you cannot
  source it, write NOT-MEASURED.
- Every numeric claim carries **value + units + scope + class + source + falsifier**. A number
  without units or scope is a defect.
- **SIGNUM SIGNUM MANET.** The signal and the commentary about the signal travel separately: the
  measured value goes in the table, the interpretation goes in the prose. Never smuggle an
  interpretation into a value. (White & Seymour title their paper "…proportional to body mass^2/3";
  the *title* is commentary, the *CI* is the signal. Read the CI.)
- **Banned in author voice** (quote-with-attribution only): *verified, secure, guaranteed, certified,
  self-aware, conscious, AGI, intelligent*. **`proven` is reserved for UNI-ledger status and never
  describes nature's science.** Use observed / measured / replicated / modeled / BOUNDED / PENDING /
  CONTESTED.
- **TRUE** signals (falsifiable, reproducible, recalibratable) and **HONEST** signals (lived
  experience, never calibrated) stay sovereign. A chakra-frequency table is INADMISSIBLE as physics
  and may be recorded as an HONEST/cultural signal — never as a TRUE/measured one, and never
  converted from one to the other.
- **"Full human" and "the next evolution beyond human" are permanent open questions** —
  QUAESTIO-APERTA. Never a target, never a milestone, never a deliverable.
- Observed / claimed / inferred / unknown stay visibly distinct.

---

## The crosswalk (the two ledgers, side by side)

Each row pairs a UNI fence value with the NATURA class it **superficially resembles** — because the
resemblance is the trap. The last column is the load-bearing one.

| UNI fence (CLAIM-LEDGER) | Look-alike NATURA class | Why they are not the same | **What this can never imply about the other** |
|---|---|---|---|
| `proven` — a held, sealed, UNI-signed PASS (Class A/C), falsifier live | OBSERVED-REPLICATED | `proven` is about **UNI's own artifact** passing **UNI's own gate**. OBSERVED-REPLICATED is about **nature**, measured by **third parties**. | A replicated natural regularity **can never** make a UNI claim `proven`. A UNI `proven` row **can never** make a natural regularity replicated, or count as evidence about nature. |
| `designed` — a typed/signed spec exists, build partial or unverified | MODELED | `designed` is an intention about UNI. MODELED is a fitted account of nature, conditional on assumptions. | A model of nature that fits **can never** discharge a UNI design gate. A signed UNI design **can never** be evidence about how nature works. |
| `hypothesized` — a stated UNI mechanism, no sealed gate (Class U) | HYPOTHESIZED | Same word, different subject: one is UNI's open mechanism, one is nature's. | Nature's open mechanism **can never** move a UNI rung. UNI's open mechanism **can never** settle a scientific dispute. |
| `not-yet-built` — no engine, no run, no gate | NOT-MEASURED | `not-yet-built` is an absence in **UNI's build**. NOT-MEASURED is an absence in **the literature**. | UNI not having built it **can never** be evidence nature lacks the value. Nature lacking a measurement **can never** be a reason UNI cannot build — nor an excuse to invent the number. |
| *(no UNI equivalent — the ledger's four states are PASS/FAIL/NEGATIVE/PENDING)* | OBSERVED-CONTESTED | The UNI ledger has no contested state. Nature's live disputes are carried **whole**, both positions named. | A contested exponent **can never** be cited as settled to move a UNI row. UNI's four-state ledger **can never** flatten a live scientific dispute into one number. |
| `NEGATIVE` (ledger state) — a held UNI run that missed its pre-registered bar | INADMISSIBLE | A UNI NEGATIVE is a **result UNI earned**. INADMISSIBLE is a **claim about nature** that failed observation or was never falsifiable. | A nature claim's inadmissibility **can never** be recorded as a UNI NEGATIVE. A UNI NEGATIVE **can never** be a statement about nature. |
| `NEGATIVE` (ledger state) — *(second look-alike, added 2026-07-15)* | SUPERSEDED | Both describe something that lost — which is exactly why they are confusable. A UNI NEGATIVE is **UNI's own run** missing **UNI's own pre-registered bar**. SUPERSEDED is a **published value about nature** that its own field retracted, withdrew, or contradicted. Different subject, different authority, different repair. | A retracted natural value **can never** be recorded as a UNI NEGATIVE, or counted among UNI's published negatives. A UNI NEGATIVE **can never** supersede a value in the literature. **This is why the NATURA class is named SUPERSEDED and not NEGATIVE:** the token `NEGATIVE` belongs to the UNI ledger, and one token may not serve both vocabularies. |
| *(no UNI equivalent)* | OBSERVED-SINGLE | The UNI fence has no value for "built and measured once, never independently reproduced" — a UNI PASS is a **held, sealed gate**, not a lone reading. | A single unreplicated natural measurement **can never** move a UNI rung — **least of all this class**, which exists precisely to stop one study from being read as settled. A UNI PASS **can never** stand in for a missing replication in the literature. |
| *(no UNI equivalent — `not-yet-built` is the nearest, and it is not close)* | NOT-SOURCED · NOT-CONFIRMED · NOT-LOCATED | These record a gap in **this corpus's homework**, not in UNI's build and not in nature. | An untraced citation **can never** be evidence about UNI's build state in either direction. And **none of the three may ever be read as NOT-MEASURED** — "we could not find the source" is not "nature has not been asked." That merge would convert a research failure into a claim about the frontier of science. |

---

## The map of the wing

**Reference chapters — `encyclopedia/wing-NATURA/`**

| Chapter | What it answers |
|---|---|
| NA-00 — How to read this wing | *this chapter* — the twelve classes (six as designed, six registered by amendment 2026-07-15), the cardinal rule, the crosswalk |
| NA-01 — Nature as the authority | why the already-run experiment is authoritative; convergence as constraint-optimum; the Gould & Lewontin counterweight, in full |
| NA-02 — The one loop | perceive → predict → act → update, as nature runs it and as the design method uses it |
| NA-03 — How to make new science | falsifiers, pre-registration, tuned baselines, discriminators, and how a negative gets published |
| NA-04 — Mind / body / world | the typed blanket split; interoception; why WORLD ⊥ BODY ⊥ MIND is a modelling commitment, not a metaphysics |

## Amendment record (2026-07-15)

**This is a calibrate-down event on NA-00.** The chapter overclaimed; the corpus measured it; the
wording moves **down** to the measured value and the strike is carried in the open. Calibration in
this repo only ever moves wording down to what was observed, and the prior wording **stays on
record** — the strike above, and this entry. A reader who is told only the corrected number has been
handed a conclusion; a reader who is shown the strike has been handed the evidence.

### AMENDMENT 2026-07-15-A — the six-class vocabulary was incomplete

| | |
|---|---|
| **What NA-00 declared** | *"This wing uses six classes and only six."* Falsifier #2 pre-registered the refutation: *"The six classes are not exhaustive or not disjoint. Exhibit a real nature claim in the NA/CN chapters that cannot be placed in exactly one of the six."* |
| **What the corpus observed** | **72 of 919 ledger rows (7.8%) carried a class string outside the six.** Not one counter-example — **seventy-two**, written by the chapters themselves, before anyone went looking. Breakdown as extracted: `OBSERVED` (bare) 42 · `NOT-SOURCED` 20 · `NEGATIVE` 3 · `HONEST-class` 1 · `MODELED-CONTESTED` 1 · `NOT-CONFIRMED` 1 · `NOT-LOCATED` 1 · `NONDUM FALSIFICABILIS` 1 · no class carried 1 · no evidence class (definitional) 1. |
| **Verdict** | **Falsifier #2 FIRED, on both halves.** *Not exhaustive:* 42 rows were measured-but-never-replicated and fit none of the six. *Not disjoint:* MODELED and OBSERVED-CONTESTED overlap (`CN12-31`), and two rows carry two classes because two parts of the row differ in standing. The six-class design is **refuted as stated.** |
| **Who found it** | **The chapters did — not a reviewer, not an audit.** CN-06 and CN-07 both recorded the gap explicitly *while writing*, and CN-07 stated the reason exactly: *"OBSERVED-REPLICATED asserts a replication that did not happen, and OBSERVED-CONTESTED asserts a dispute that does not exist. Both are false, in opposite directions."* Both flagged the fix as belonging at the ledger; both noted `NATURE-LEDGER.md` **did not exist yet**, which is why the gap stayed open. It exists now, and it closed the gap it was built to catch. |
| **What changed** | Six classes → **twelve, in three groups** (measured / derived / fenced). Registered: `OBSERVED-SINGLE`, `MODELED-CONTESTED`, `SUPERSEDED`, `NOT-SOURCED`, `NOT-CONFIRMED`, `NOT-LOCATED`. Four rows registered as **deliberately unclassed**; the compound-row convention registered. |
| **What did NOT change** | **No value, no source, no falsifier, in any row, in either artifact** — machine-checked across all 919 rows: of 10 columns, only the class column differs, on 48 rows. This was a **re-class only** — relabelling rows to the class that was always true of them. **Not one row changed evidentiary standing, and not one row left the six.** The six-class subtotal was **847 as the ledger published it** (§5.1) and is **847 now**. The two artifacts were re-classed in lockstep and still agree on all 443 shared classed entries; every `ledger_row_id` is unchanged and in its original order. |
| **The one counting subtlety, disclosed** | Under a **strict leading-token** count, the *old* text yields **846**, not 847 — because `CN05-31`'s class cell read *"rung MODELED; overall band OBSERVED-REPLICATED"*, which does not **begin** with a class token and so does not parse mechanically. The published §5.1 counted it at MODELED anyway (that is where its 251 came from), which is why the published subtotal was 847. This amendment re-ordered that cell to *"MODELED (the ladder rung); OBSERVED-REPLICATED (the overall band)"* so it now **parses as what it was always counted as**. The row's value, source, falsifier and **evidentiary standing are untouched**; only the cell's word order moved. This is recorded because a subtotal that appears stable at 847 under one rule and shifts 846→847 under another **must** have the difference named, or the stability is an illusion the reader cannot audit. |
| **Verified how** | [`tools/verify_class_vocabulary.py`](../../tools/verify_class_vocabulary.py) — the operable form of falsifier #2, **written before the amendment** and run against both artifacts. Pre-amendment it reported 47 ledger + 24 K20 rows needing re-labelling; post-amendment it reports **0 out of vocabulary, 919/919 rows placed.** Re-run it after any edit to either artifact. **⚠ READ WITH [AMENDMENT 2026-07-15-C](#amendment-2026-07-15-c--the-amendments-scope-was-narrower-than-this-record-read): "both artifacts" was the *whole* of the scope, and the chapters were not in it. This cell's "0 out of vocabulary" was true of the ledger and K20 and false of the wing — 52 chapter rows still carried pre-amendment strings. The wording stands as written, struck, because it is the evidence of how the gap read from inside.** |
| **Standing** | This amendment is itself falsifiable. It is **not** a claim that twelve is correct — only that twelve is what 919 rows measured. Thirteen is a finding, not a failure. |

**What this event is evidence of, stated without flattery.** A chapter made a clean, checkable
declaration; the work refuted it; the refutation was recorded by the refuting chapters rather than
hidden; and the fix waited for an instrument that could count. That is the method working — and it is
**not** a result about nature, not a rung, and not evidence of anything about UNI. **The program
position is untouched: ~2 of 11+ rungs earned.** A vocabulary that can now name its own gaps is a
vocabulary, not an achievement.

### AMENDMENT 2026-07-15-C — the amendment's scope was narrower than this record read

**A second calibrate-down, on the record above rather than on the vocabulary.** Amendment
2026-07-15-A is not withdrawn: twelve classes still stand, and no row's standing moves. What was
wrong was the **scope**, and the fact that nothing in the record said so.

| | |
|---|---|
| **What 2026-07-15-A actually closed** | **`NATURE-LEDGER.md` and `K20`. Those two files, and nothing else.** The record above says so if read closely — *"machine-checked across all 919 rows"*, *"both artifacts"*, *"either artifact"* — but it never says what is **outside** those words, and every reader who took *"0 out of vocabulary"* as a statement about **the wing** read it the way it was written to be read. |
| **What was still broken** | **52 rows in 10 of the 23 chapters still carried PRE-amendment class strings** — the chapters' own `## The numbers` tables, i.e. the artifacts the ledger *extracts*, and the artifacts a reader actually reads. Breakdown: bare/qualified `OBSERVED` **42** · `NEGATIVE` **3** · `as above` **5** · CN-05 cells not leading with a token **2**. The ledger had been re-classed away from its own sources, so for one day the extraction and the extracted disagreed in the one column the amendment existed to fix. |
| **Why the verifier said PASS anyway** | **It never opened a chapter.** `tools/verify_class_vocabulary.py` checked the ledger and K20 — the artifacts it was written beside — and reported **0** while the real chapter residue was **52**. Its scope was correct for what it checked and silent about what it did not, which is the defect: **a verifier that does not print its scope cannot be audited, and a PASS from an unstated scope is a false negative wearing a green result.** |
| **What changed now** | (1) All **52** chapter cells re-classed **in lockstep with the ledger** — the ledger already carried the correct class and the reasoning for each, and each cell was mirrored from it, never invented. Only the **class token** moved: the chapters' own qualifier text was kept verbatim rather than overwritten with the ledger's shorter restatement of it. `as above` was resolved to the literal cell of the row it points at (`NA10-30`). **No value, no scope, no source, no falsifier was touched — machine-asserted per row, per column.** (2) The verifier now scans the **chapters** as a third scope, counted on its own line, and **prints every scope it covers** before it prints any result. (3) It now also checks that each chapter's table still aligns row-for-row with the ledger, so ledger/chapter divergence is itself a finding. |
| **The tokenizer moved a number, so it is declared** | The verifier's `lead_token()` only stripped `**` when a cell was bold **end to end**. Chapter cells routinely bold the token and leave the qualifier plain (`**MODELED** (as above; unreplicated)`), so on first scan the chapters reported **90** out-of-vocabulary rows: **52 real + 38 false positives** whose class was never in doubt. Emphasis is now stripped before the leading-token match — safe by construction, since every registered token is `[A-Z-]` only. **90 → 52**, and 52 is the number fixed against. A count that moves because the instrument changed is not a count until the instrument is named. |
| **Verified how** | Three **positive controls**, because a scope that reports zero is worthless until it is shown able to report non-zero: (1) a bare `OBSERVED` re-injected into a CN-09 class cell → caught as `CN09-02`, **exit 1**; (2) `NEGATIVE` re-injected into CN-01 → caught as `CN01-34`, **exit 1**; (3) a chapter table row deleted → caught as a ledger/chapter misalignment, **exit 1**. Restored, the run is **0 in every scope, exit 0**. The chapters' class counts now equal the ledger's exactly (918 = 919 − `NA03-16`, which lives in NA-03's prose) — an independent check that the mirror is a mirror. |
| **Standing** | This does **not** raise anything. It closes a scope gap that should never have shipped, found by an outside audit and not by this wing. |
| **50 or 52? Both, and the difference is the instrument** | The audit reported **50 rows across 9 files**; this amendment re-classed **52 across 10**. Neither is a typo, and the gap is fully accounted: **50 is `reader/build.py`'s build-note count**, which finds a registered class **anywhere** in a cell; **52 is the leading-token count** this wing's verifier and §5 actually use. Reconciled exactly: `52 − 5 + 3 = 50`. The reader **misses 5** real defects because each names a class somewhere but not first — `CN05-06`, `CN05-31` (the two §3 already names), `CN06-30` ("…the latency; **MODELED**…"), and `CN08-05` / `CN08-24` (whose qualifier reads "downgraded from **OBSERVED-REPLICATED**", so the cell cites the very class it was demoted *from*). The reader **adds 3** that are not defects at all — `CN04-22`, `CN11-59`, `CN12-41`, deliberately unclassed and registered as such. **Two instruments, two answers, one corpus: the number is not a fact until the rule that produced it is named.** The 52 stands because a class cell must **lead** with its class — a row whose class must be inferred from a qualifier is exactly the ambiguity the amendment re-ordered `CN05-31` to remove. |

**The honest residue — what these amendments did NOT fix. Two lines, not one.**

1. **The 22 untraced rows.** The `NOT-SOURCED` (20), `NOT-CONFIRMED` (1), and `NOT-LOCATED` (1) rows
   are now *correctly labelled*, which is **not** the same as *fixed*. Twenty-two rows carry values
   this corpus could not fully trace. **Naming a defect precisely is not repairing it.** Each carries
   the falsifier that would close it, and closing them is real work that has not been done.
2. **The 52 chapter rows, and the day they were wrong.** Amendment 2026-07-15-A **closed the ledger
   and K20 only**; **52 chapter rows across 10 files carried the old class strings until
   AMENDMENT 2026-07-15-C** re-classed them. They are labelled correctly now. What is *not* repaired
   is the reason it happened: the amendment was written against the artifacts its verifier could
   see, the verifier's scope was never printed, and **nothing in the record disclosed the gap — it
   took an outside audit to find it.** The instrument is fixed; the habit that produced it is not
   demonstrated fixed, and one closed scope gap is not evidence there is no second one. **The only
   defence is a scope that prints itself, and it now does.**

---

## Falsifier (operable)

This chapter is refuted if any of the following is shown:

1. **A merge is legitimate.** Exhibit one sound inference in which a NATURA-class row raises,
   lowers, or discharges a row in `CLAIM-LEDGER.md` (or the reverse) without a separate UNI gate. If
   such an inference exists, the cardinal rule is wrong and this wing is mis-architected.
2. **The classes are not exhaustive or not disjoint.** Exhibit a real nature claim in the NA/CN
   chapters that cannot be placed in one of the registered classes.
   > **THIS FALSIFIER HAS FIRED — 2026-07-15, on 72 rows, on both halves.** See
   > [§ Amendment record](#amendment-record-2026-07-15). It is left standing and **unweakened**,
   > against the amended twelve, because a falsifier that fired once is the most likely one to fire
   > again — and it is now mechanised as
   > [`tools/verify_class_vocabulary.py`](../../tools/verify_class_vocabulary.py), which fails on any
   > row outside the registered vocabulary. The count of classes is **not** part of the claim; the
   > claim is that every row can be honestly placed. A thirteenth class is a finding, and the
   > amendment procedure above is how it gets registered.
3. **A crosswalk "can never" is too strong.** Exhibit a case where one of the six non-implications in
   the crosswalk table blocks a *valid* inference.
4. **A number here is unsourced or wrong.** Any value in the table that cannot be traced to its cited
   source, or that the source does not support, is a defect in this chapter — report it and the row
   is corrected or demoted to NOT-MEASURED.
5. **NOT-MEASURED was premature.** Produce the pre-registered, replicated measurement for either
   NOT-MEASURED row. The row is then reclassified — which is the system working, not failing.

---

## Recorded INADMISSIBLE / NEGATIVE (first-class, inline)

- **"The golden ratio is a universal design law of nature." — INADMISSIBLE as stated.** Unfalsifiable
  and cherry-picked: it names no measurand, no scope, and no observation that could refute it.
  *Receipt:* the mechanism-bearing version of the claim is real and earned — Douady & Couder (1992)
  produced golden-angle divergence in a physical ferrofluid experiment from repulsion dynamics alone.
  And the universality version fails on its own poster child: **18% of scored sunflower counts are
  non-Fibonacci** (Swinton & Ochu 2016). Honour the mechanism; reject the universal law. **This pair
  is the template for every mystical-adjacent item in this wing.**
- **"432 Hz is nature's true tuning." — INADMISSIBLE.** A4 = 440 Hz is a standards convention
  (ISO 16:1975, 440 ± 0.5 Hz), not a natural constant, and 432 Hz is a different convention. The claim
  names no measurand.
- **"Schumann 7.83 Hz entrains the human brain because alpha is ~8–13 Hz." — INADMISSIBLE as stated.**
  Both frequencies are real and separately replicated. The *bridge* names no mechanism, no
  dose–response, and no falsifier, and the SR field is ambient at picotesla strength — the effect size
  is NOT-MEASURED (above). If the claim is re-stated with a measurand and a pre-registered
  dose–response, it is admissible and becomes a HYPOTHESIZED row. It is not there yet.
- **Chakra frequency tables — INADMISSIBLE as physics.** No measurand. Recordable as an HONEST /
  cultural signal, sovereign and uncalibrated, never crossed into the TRUE store.
- **NEGATIVE, carried standing:** "nature does it this way" has **never** been sufficient. Every
  biomimetic design in the CN recipes that fails to beat a tuned conventional baseline on its
  pre-registered metric is recorded NEGATIVE and printed — not retried until it wins.

---

## HONEST FENCE — NOT-MEASURED

This chapter measures nothing. It is a constitution: definitional, governance-class, and it asserts
no regularity of nature in its own voice. Every number above is a **worked example carrying its own
class and its own citation**, and none of them is claimed here — they are demonstrations of the
vocabulary, borrowed from their sources and returned to them.

NOT-MEASURED is the correct and honest fence for a chapter with no measurand, and it is recorded
rather than dodged. The UNI-side analogue (`status: method`, fenced `proven`-as-governance in
CB-01) is **not** available here and is deliberately not borrowed: `proven` is reserved for the UNI
ledger, and this wing does not get to use it — including for itself.

---

## Not claimed

This chapter does **not** assert:

- that any UNI claim is `proven`, `designed`, or at any rung — it makes no UNI claim at all, and the
  program position (**~2 of 11+ rungs earned**) is untouched;
- that nature is optimal, that convergence proves optimality, or that any observed regularity is an
  adaptation — Gould & Lewontin (1979) travels with the doctrine permanently;
- that the golden angle, the Schumann resonance, alpha, or any other frequency has significance
  beyond the scope printed in its row;
- that any biomimetic design works — no design has been benchmarked in this chapter;
- that the twelve classes are the only defensible taxonomy, or that twelve is a settled or correct
  number — only that they are this wing's, that twelve is what 919 rows measured rather than a design
  target, and that they are never merged with the UNI four. **The chapter has already been wrong
  about this once** (it declared six; see [§ Amendment record](#amendment-record-2026-07-15)), which
  is the strongest available reason not to claim the new number is final;
- that re-classing the 72 rows **repaired** them. 22 rows (NOT-SOURCED · NOT-CONFIRMED · NOT-LOCATED)
  are now correctly labelled as un-traced, which is a description of a defect, not its repair;
- anything whatever about "full human" or "the next evolution beyond human." Both are
  **QUAESTIO-APERTA** — permanent open questions, never targets, never milestones, never deliverables.
  CN-12 is a chapter about a question, not a roadmap to an outcome.

**Falsify any row.** The two NOT-MEASURED rows are invitations, and the INADMISSIBLE rows are held
open for anyone who can re-state them with a measurand.
